violet-glow.$description: Violet Glow — Primary action fill, brand accent, hero glow origin, logo mark — the charged purple that signals generation and AI intent

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Gradient deep stop, brand purple core — anchors hero radial bloom and logo gradient ramp

soft-lilac.$description: Soft Lilac — Gradient highlight stop — outer edge of brand gradient where violet dissolves into the dark canvas

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Page canvas, card surface — the foundational darkness everything floats on

void-black.$description: Void Black — Deepest surface tier, shadow base — used for shadow color and deepest elevation sink

graphite.$description: Graphite — Card and container borders — hairline outlines that separate dark surfaces without lifting them

carbon.$description: Carbon — Secondary borders, subtle dividers on dark sections

slate.$description: Slate — Muted border accent for low-emphasis containers and section dividers

frost.$description: Frost — Primary text on dark surfaces, hairline borders — the default ink

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Headline text, input field fill, high-emphasis foreground — maximum contrast moments

pewter.$description: Pewter — Muted body text, secondary copy, metadata — reads as quiet information

satoshi-variable.$description: Primary UI and body typeface — carries product voice across all body, button, input, card, and subheading contexts. The half-step weights (480, 540, 560) between 400 and 640 give the system finely tuned confidence: 400 for body, 480 for soft headings, 540 for buttons and subheads, 640 for emphasized UI labels. Substitute: Inter or General Sans

clashgrotesk-variable.$description: Display headline typeface — reserved for the hero statement. Clash Grotesk's geometric character at weight 540 with -0.008em tracking creates a distinctive editorial voice that Satoshi cannot replicate at scale. The single weight/size usage makes it a moment, not a pattern. Substitute: Clash Display or Space Grotesk Bold
